definitions.explanation: The act of coming nearer or drawing close to something or someone.
Developing a closer relationship with someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}している。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}して⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see a car approaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：00320_nippon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{接近|せっきん}する⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The large typhoon is expected to make its closest approach to Japan tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧{接近|せっきん}した。
examples.english: The two of them suddenly became close.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{接近|せっきん}する⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Through work, I had more opportunities to get close to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{共通|きょうつう}→共通：02590_kyoutsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{接近|せっきん}した。
examples.english: A shared hobby brought the two of them closer together.

notes:
{接近|せっきん} describes physical approach or getting closer in a relationship. It's commonly used in weather reports for approaching storms.

USAGE:
- Weather: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}する (typhoon approaching)
- Military/aviation: ⟦{敵機|てっき}→敵機：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん} (enemy aircraft approaching)
- Relationships: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}する (two people getting closer)
- Traffic: ⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん} (vehicle approaching)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: to approach, get close (more general)
- ⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to approach, draw near (often with sense of pressure)
- ⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧: to separate, move away (opposite)
